name: BOH
summary: BOH, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-β-methoxyphenethylamine or as β-methoxy-MDPEA, is a drug of the phenethylamine, MDxx, and BOx families. It is the β-methoxy analogue of 3,4-methylenedioxyphenethylamine (MDPEA) and is also more distantly related to methylone (β-keto-MDMA).

pharmacology.text: On account of its structural similarity to norepinephrine, BOH might be purely adrenergic in nature.

summaryZh: BOH，分子式C10H13NO3，是一種苯乙胺衍生物可看做3,4-亞甲二氧基苯乙胺的β-甲氧基衍生物，結構上與3,4-亞甲二氧基甲卡西酮類似。

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical with no medical use, known from laboratory work on phenethylamines.
uses.zh: 它是罕見的研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，僅見於苯乙胺類的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是罕见的研究化学品，没有医疗用途，仅见于苯乙胺类的实验室研究。

fact.en: Its structure is strikingly close to noradrenaline, the body's own alerting messenger, which has led to the suggestion that it may act on adrenergic rather than serotonin receptors.
fact.zh: 它的結構與身體自有的警覺傳訊物質正腎上腺素極為相似，因此有人推測它可能作用於腎上腺素受體而非血清素受體。
fact.zhHans: 它的结构与身体自有的警觉传讯物质正肾上腺素极为相似，因此有人推测它可能作用于肾上腺素受体而非血清素受体。
